subject: reorder() no longer functioning as expected

messages.author: 53876b6270ad9337
messages.subject: reorder() no longer functioning as expected
parts:
In previous versions - I used to use reorder(x,y) in the aesthetic to reorder factor variable (x) by some numeric column (y). This no longer seems to function. 

When using coord_flip(), I used to be able to cheat, with something like reorder(x,-as.numeric(dat$x)) to ensure that the flip kept the factors in my preferred order. But this doesn't seem to work anymore. 

Can anyone show me how to maintain the original factor order when using coord_flip() and also, speak to what's happened to the functionality available in reorder()?

messages.subject: Re: reorder() no longer functioning as expected
parts:
I think we'll need a reproducible example from you because the
following example from the ggplot2 book (p. 124) seems to work for me:

mpg2 <- subset(mpg, cyl != 5 & drv %in% c('4', 'f'))
mpg3 <- within(mpg2, {
model <- reorder(model, cty)
manufacturer <- reorder(manufacturer, -cty)
} )
qplot(cty, model, data = mpg3)
qplot(cty, model, data = mpg3) + coord_flip() +
opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(angle = 90))
